scenarios.name: 2. 地址画像（单地址事件）
scenarios.sql:
SELECT block_number, transaction_hash, address, topic0, topic1, topic2
		FROM read_parquet('E:/codex/etl/stress-data/bsc_real/sqd-200k-warehouse/logs.parquet') WHERE address = '0x55d398326f99059ff775485246999027b3197955' ORDER BY block_number DESC LIMIT 100

scenarios.name: 3. 多地址 SEMI JOIN（1000 地址）
scenarios.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM read_parquet('E:/codex/etl/stress-data/bsc_real/sqd-200k-warehouse/logs.parquet') t
			SEMI JOIN read_csv('E:/codex/etl/stress-data/bsc_real/sqd-200k-warehouse/bench-addr-1000.csv', header=false, columns={'addr':'VARCHAR'}) a ON t.address = a.addr

scenarios.name: 4. Token 流向（Top 发送方）
scenarios.sql:
SELECT topic1 AS from_addr, COUNT(*) AS n FROM read_parquet('E:/codex/etl/stress-data/bsc_real/sqd-200k-warehouse/logs.parquet')
		WHERE topic0 IN ('0xddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef','0xc3d58168c5ae7397731d063d5bbf3d657854427343f4c083240f7aacaa2d0f62','0x4a39dc06d4c0dbc64b70af90fd698a233a518aa5d07e595d983b8c0526c8f7fb') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10

scenarios.name: 5. 时间范围（Block 窗口）
scenarios.sql:
SELECT TRY_CAST(block_number AS UBIGINT) AS block_number, COUNT(*) AS n FROM read_parquet('E:/codex/etl/stress-data/bsc_real/sqd-200k-warehouse/logs.parquet')
		WHERE TRY_CAST(block_number AS UBIGINT) BETWEEN 107153360 AND 107153560 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 20

scenarios.name: 6. 聚合排行（地址活跃）
scenarios.sql: SELECT address, COUNT(*) AS n FROM read_parquet('E:/codex/etl/stress-data/bsc_real/sqd-200k-warehouse/logs.parquet') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10
